name: LoftByEtab
note: Curl confirmed a live Salla store (SAR pricing, checkout) for a Jeddah-HQ'd home-furnishings/accessories concept store under ETAB International (Zahran Holding). Gate 1 geography and approved home/general-merchandise category both clear.

name: lomar
note: Well-known Saudi (Jeddah) D2C fashion house since 2002, 14 stores plus live e-commerce selling its own thobes/abayas/accessories. Its in-house factory serves its own retail brand (vertically integrated), so it is fashion retail, not a B2B manufacturer.

name: loofah
note: Live Saudi perfume/home-fragrance and personal-care store (SAR, free-shipping-over-349 banner, broad beauty categories). Approved high-repeat beauty category; all gates clear.

name: loudy-plus
note: Real perfume e-commerce with a broad range (women's/men's/unisex/hair perfumes/musk/incense). Approved repeat-purchase beauty category, Saudi storefront; no red flags.

name: maatic
note: Gate 1 geography: live Shopify apparel store but its config is currency USD / country US / locale en_US with zero Saudi signals (no SAR, no KSA address) and it is absent from Saudi fashion coverage, so an in-country Saudi HQ cannot be established. The original 'Yes' was a pure keyword match with no geography evidence.

name: maestropizza
note: Riyadh-HQ'd Saudi QSR pizza chain (Daily Food Co.), 140 outlets, genuine app/web ordering with basket and loyalty. F&B/QSR is high-frequency; all gates clear.

name: Manuel Market
note: Gate 4 digital channel: the domain returned HTTP 000 / DNS failure on three independent attempts (WebFetch and two curls), so a live cart/checkout cannot be confirmed. The Jeddah/Riyadh luxury supermarket is real, but the pass rests on web-search inference rather than a confirmed live store, exactly the flagged pattern.

name: Masco Saudi Arabia
note: Gate 2 B2B/wholesale hybrid: described as importing/exporting stationery since 2003 serving 'individual and corporate clients,' and MASCO-brand products are stocked across Carrefour/Amazon.sa/Noon (supplying other retailers). Its own site reads D2C, but the wholesale/trading dimension means the hard B2B exclusion cannot be confidently cleared.

name: Masdar - مصدر
note: Gate 2 hard-fail: Masdar (Al Muhaidib Group) is a building/construction-materials distributor selling steel, timber, cement, plumbing, electrical, hardware and fasteners (105 branches, 80,000+ SKUs). Construction materials plus distribution are both explicitly excluded regardless of the online store.

name: Matajer Al Saudia
note: Real multi-branch Saudi grocery chain with weekly promotions and a live online store. Grocery/hypermarket is the highest repeat-purchase approved category; all gates clear.

name: Match | ماتش
note: Real Saudi perfume e-commerce with a full category range (women's/men's/unisex/musk/niche/gift sets/home fresheners) and genuine customer reviews. Approved repeat-purchase beauty category; no red flags.

name: Mehbaj
note: Genuine specialty-food e-commerce (dried fruits/coffee/nuts/spices/seeds/pulses) with a loyalty program and physical branches. Falls under approved grocery/specialty-food with solid repeat purchase.

name: METRO BRAZIL
note: Gate 1 hard-fail: METRO BRAZIL's global HQ is São Paulo, Brazil, with its regional HQ in Dubai CommerCity (UAE). Neither is Saudi Arabia, so the account (tagged Saudi) fails the in-country HQ requirement.

name: miraymano
note: Gate 2 marketplace concern: MIRA Y MANO self-describes as a curated multibrand platform for 'independent, ethical fashion designers' that functions as a marketplace of third-party designers rather than clearly holding first-party inventory. Marketplace/aggregator models are a general exclusion and first-party status cannot be confirmed.

name: mlwsocks
note: Despite the socks-brand name, independently confirmed as a broad Riyadh-based general-merchandise/lifestyle-gifting retailer (socks, homewear, pajamas, blankets, bags, towels, treats/candy, gifts, stationery; 20+ categories). Not narrow; Gate 3 breadth satisfied.

name: Modern Electronics - MEC (AL-Faisaliah Group)
note: Broad multi-category consumer-electronics and general-merchandise retailer (Al-Faisaliah Group's Saudi retail arm) with a large live transactional catalog well above the SKU floor. Approved electronics category; all gates clear.

name: Mohammed Alkhuraiji Industrial Company
note: Gate 2 hard-fail: independently confirmed as 'Alkhuraiji Factory for Perfumes and Cosmetics,' a manufacturer/factory (est. 1982, Second Industrial City) that also offers private-label B2B production for other brands. Manufacturing plus B2B supply are excluded regardless of the D2C Salla storefront; the prior reversal to 'retail' overlooked the manufacturing hard-exclude.

name: Mohammed Siraj Attar & Bros
note: Curl confirmed a live, substantial Salla D2C store (104 add-to-cart instances, SAR pricing) for a Jeddah men's-fabric/ghutra/shemagh retailer. Fabric/textile retail for garment-making is an explicit Gate 3 pass; the 'textile manufacturing' label reflects vertical integration behind a genuine consumer storefront, like Lomar.

name: mohjewelry
note: Live Saudi jewelry store (necklaces/bracelets/rings/earrings/bridal), EN/AR, lifetime guarantee, free shipping over 600. Jewelry is broad enough to pass Gate 3; all gates clear.

name: monaalshebil
note: Curl confirmed a robust live Shopify store with active SAR currency and a large catalog (1,600+ SAR price instances) for a Saudi women's-fashion designer (blazers/dresses/abayas/suits) with return policy and stockist network. Approved fashion category, real scale.

name: Motory
note: Automotive is normally a Gate 2 hard-fail, but Gate 5b app-rescue applies: Motory's cars-marketplace app is a leading Saudi auto app with 100K+ installs (corroborated on Aptoide), above the 50k threshold, and HQ is confirmed Jeddah. Qualifies via the app-download path.

name: Munch Bakery منش بيكري
note: The marketing homepage has no cart, but the brand runs a genuine POS-integrated ordering platform (order.munchbakery.com on Taker.io) with real payments, 15% VAT and loyalty, plus a multi-city Saudi branch network and delivery-app presence. F&B/bakery is high-frequency; Gate 4 satisfied via the live ordering platform.

name: My Little Home | بيتي الصغير
note: Live WooCommerce store selling home textiles and decor (bedding, bath, cushions) with a confirmed Saudi address in structured data and a genuine deep catalog (100+ SKUs). Approved home category; all gates clear.

name: Nahda Modern Company LLC
note: Gate 4 digital channel: nahda.group root and /store return only an empty splash/SPA shell (no cart, product or SAR signals) on independent curl, matching the prior 'Click here to enter' gate. The 20+ branch Jeddah hypermarket is clearly real (grocery, approved), but a live transactional online store cannot be confirmed and the pass leans on inference.

name: Nana
note: Vertically-integrated Saudi quick-commerce grocery retailer operating its own dark stores (up to 2,000 SKUs each, 22,000+ products, 30+ Riyadh dark stores) with a live cart. Grocery is high-frequency; scale confirmed via both substantiality and app downloads.

name: NAQI نقي
note: Gate 2 hard-fail: naqi.sa is Naqi Water Company, engaged in production/bottling of purified water plus wholesale of bottled water, soft drinks and juices. That is manufacturing plus B2B wholesale (and a narrow single beverage line under Gate 3), all excluded; the 'strong retail signal' tag was a keyword false positive.

name: Naseem
note: Gate 1 geography: Naseem is a 'Middle East' regional flowers/cakes/gifts operator whose only listed contact is a Dubai (+971 4) landline, with both UAE and KSA in the footer, on a .sa storefront. An in-country Saudi HQ cannot be established; this matches the excluded foreign-HQ-with-.sa-storefront pattern (Ferns N Petals/desertcart).

name: Natural Touch ناتشورال تاتش
note: Live Saudi beauty store with a broad assortment (skincare/haircare/body/makeup/perfume/home/massage) and active promotions. Approved repeat-purchase beauty category; no red flags.

name: neyam
note: Gate 3 hard-fail: Neyam is a sleep/segmented-foam mattress brand ('redefining comfort through segmented foam'). Mattresses are an explicit confirmed narrow/low-repeat fail regardless of e-commerce quality; the generic 'retail signal' tag missed the actual product line.

name: nice
note: Real Saudi home-goods e-commerce (decor/furniture/kitchen/tableware/bath/bedding) with store finder and KSA-wide shipping. Broad approved home category; all gates clear.

name: NICE ONE
note: Large, well-known Saudi beauty e-commerce platform with an extremely broad catalog (makeup/perfume/health/devices/nails/gifts). Approved high-repeat beauty category, clear scale; all gates pass.

name: Ninja ?? نينجا
note: Riyadh-HQ'd (2022) quick-commerce retailer running its own dark-store first-party inventory across a broad grocery/convenience assortment, confirmed as a $1.5B-valuation Saudi unicorn. Grocery is approved and high-frequency; it is a direct retailer, not a third-party aggregator marketplace.
